research.primaryRule: Underdog between +3.5 and +7 with at least 2 of 3 advantages (rest/schedule, non-explosive down-to-down efficiency, QB passing efficiency/YPA) plus a verified live moneyline better than the frozen fair-ML estimate.
research.spreadEdgeRole: Spread-model edge is confidence/context, not a hard qualification gate.
research.historicalStatus: exploratory discovery sample; not independently validated with actual historical sportsbook moneylines
secondaryRules: ML Watchlist may include +3.5-to-+7 dogs that do not clear the full 2-of-3 profile when useful to monitor.
v1.0 history remains preserved; v1.1 is prospective only.
research.parlayNote: Only independently qualifying live-priced Specials may be combined; never force a parlay.

pricing.executionRule: After the 2-of-3 profile qualifies, verified live ML must be better than model fair ML.
